title: Interop testing against other MIMI implementations
description: Survey 2026-11-02 of public MIMI implementations: Haven (havenmessenger/interop, Rust, Apache-2.0; protocol-06 JSON + TLS-PL wire lanes, content-09, room-policy; runnable mTLS hub mimi-hubd; DIVERGENCES.md; issues open, 'feedback welcome'); Phoenix R&D (phnx-im/mimi-content, active, used in production by the Air app; mimi-room-policy July 2026; mimi-protocol structs only, stale; no license file on any); nexun-foundation/mimi-rs (Apache-2.0, room-policy at -02, stalled since 2026-02). No public MIMI code found from Wire, Cisco or Matrix. Goal: test mimid against independent implementations and send what breaks upstream (their trackers or the WG).
